definitions.explanation: A length of time with defined start and end points.

examples.japanese: ⟦{試験|しけん}→試験：01422_shiken⟧{期間|きかん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{来週|らいしゅう}→来週：00746_raishuu⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: The exam period starts next week.

examples.japanese: ⟦{長|なが}い→長い：00491_nagai⟧{期間|きかん}⟦{働|はたら}いた→働く：00503_hataraku⟧。
examples.english: I worked for a long period.

examples.japanese: ⟦{契約|けいやく}→契約：02698_keiyaku⟧{期間|きかん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧1⟦{年|ねん}→年：09876_nen⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: The contract period is one year.

notes:
{期間|きかん} refers to a span of time with a defined beginning and end.

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
- {期間|きかん}⟦{中|ちゅう}→〜中：09840_chuu⟧: during the period
- {期間|きかん}⟦{限定|げんてい}→限定：10997_gentei⟧: limited time (offer)
- ⟦{有効|ゆうこう}→有効：03645_yuukou⟧{期間|きかん}: validity period
- ⟦{保証|ほしょう}→保証：03718_hoshou⟧{期間|きかん}: warranty period
- ⟦{試用|しよう}→試用：23966_shiyou⟧{期間|きかん}: trial period
- ⟦{契約|けいやく}→契約：02698_keiyaku⟧{期間|きかん}: contract term

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- ⟦{長|なが}い→長い：00491_nagai⟧{期間|きかん}: a long period
- ⟦{短|みじか}い→短い：00510_mijikai⟧{期間|きかん}: a short period
- ⟦{一定|いってい}→一定：01735_ittei⟧{期間|きかん}: a fixed period

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{期限|きげん}→期限：12861_kigen⟧: deadline, expiration date
- ⟦{時期|じき}→時期：03269_jiki⟧: time, season, period
